name: Cube-Chordal Ample Classes Definition
statement: A finite nonempty ample class is cube-chordal when the intersection graph of ALL inclusion-maximal positioned cubes contained in it is chordal, meaning that it has no induced cycle of length at least four. Two distinct maximal cubes are adjacent exactly when their vertex sets intersect.
hypotheses: Finite nonempty ample classes on the full specified ambient cube, including original constant coordinates. Empty complementary shores have the unique empty allocation. Ordinary witnesses are the integral points of the full native allocation system.
